premises.text: Selling on more than one channel lifts sales substantially, yet many merchants still do not sell multichannel
premises.evidence_span: selling on more than one channel increases her sale on average by 190%. Yet, 37% of online merchants still do not sell on more than one channel

premises.text: Multichannel selling is tedious because merchants must switch platforms and replicate listings, orders, and inventory tracking
premises.evidence_span: switching from platform to platform to manage their sales activities and keep inventory synchronized, replicating tasks like product listings, orders and sales tracking, and inventory tracking

premises.text: Syncommerce's centralized dashboard lets merchants sell, track, and manage inventory across multiple channels simultaneously
premises.evidence_span: The Syncommerce centralized dashboard allows online merchants to sell, track, and manage inventory across multiple sales channels simultaneously

premises.text: Merchants can import products from one store and publish bulk listings to another channel with channel-specific fields
premises.evidence_span: with a click of a button, Nicole publishes all her 5,000 products to her new Etsy store

premises.text: Automated real-time multi-directional inventory sync prevents overselling and manual stock updates across channels
premises.evidence_span: Due to the automated inventory synchronization that we provide, Synchromesh imports that order in real time

premises.text: Unlike competitors, Syncommerce is affordable for small businesses with real-time multi-directional sync and selectable product-data sync
premises.evidence_span: Syncommerce provides affordable and optimized solutions for small businesses. real-time multi-directional syncing of product data, and the ability to customize which product's data to sync

premises.text: Monthly subscription tiers from $40 to $200 are based on products listed and channels connected
premises.evidence_span: Our monthly subscription ranges from $40 to $200 per month. The three pricing tiers are based on the number of products listed and channels connected

value.text: Online merchants sell more across channels while working less through centralized multichannel management

secondary_value.evidence_span: increase your sales by 190% and sell cross-platform

causal_links.evidence_span: Multichannel selling can be tedious, time-consuming, and extremely difficult to manage in real time
sell, track, and manage inventory across multiple sales channels simultaneously
affordable and optimized solutions for small businesses
